artifact_review: The Router identified background texture anomalies (severity 1.5) and slight boundary bleeding (severity 1.0). The Perceptual Quality Auditor detected 'slight compression' (score 0.2), which aligns with the visual evidence of minor noise/grain. However, the Router may have underestimated the 'boundary bleeding' at the tail. In AI generations, soft edges against complex backgrounds often mask 'fusion' artifacts where the subject doesn't truly occlude the background but blends into it. The Topology Auditor's high confidence (0.97) suggests a coherent mask, but this can sometimes ignore subtle color-bleeding if the contrast is low. I agree with the severity ratings but note that the background smudging is a classic diffusion artifact indicating the model struggled with the high-frequency detail of the leaf litter.
